elements.note: Ground-bearing slab used outside the framed floor (terraces, approach). Drawn with a break line, so the length shown is indicative only.
Labelled 'S1(ด้านสั้น)' -- the detail is cut across the SHORT span, 2.50 m. Top bars run 0.65 m in from each support; the bottom mat is continuous.
Labelled 'S2(ด้านสั้น)' but NO span dimension is printed and the detail is drawn with break lines at both ends, so the short span is unknown from this sheet.
Labelled 'S3(ด้านสั้น)', 1.20 m short span -- the smallest panel, and the only one at 0.25 m bar spacing.

elements.element_id: ขยายพอกบันได
elements.note: The RC thickening (พอก) at the bottom of the stair, where the S1 floor slab steps down onto the S0 ground slab. Two 0.15 rises are dimensioned, with a 0.30 / 0.20 chain across the nosing.

warnings: SLAB SCHEDULE for the cast-in-place panels. All four are 0.10 m thick with a single Ø9 bar size; only the spacing changes (0.20 m for S0/S1/S2, 0.25 m for S3).

THE PRECAST SP PLANK IS NOT ON THIS SHEET. S-03 and S-04 tag most of the framed floor as SP (SOLID PLANK 5 cm + 5 cm topping per S-01 item 4); this sheet details only the cast-in-place S0/S1/S2/S3 panels that fill in around it.

EVERY SECTION IS CUT ACROSS THE SHORT SPAN -- S1, S2 and S3 are all captioned '(ด้านสั้น)'. The long-span steel is therefore NOT shown anywhere on this sheet; do not read these tags as the full two-way reinforcement.

S2 HAS NO SPAN DIMENSION. Its detail is drawn between break lines with only the 0.10 thickness and the bar tags, so short_span_m is left null and flagged span_not_dimensioned. S1 (2.50) and S3 (1.20) are dimensioned.

S0 is a ground-bearing slab, not a suspended one: it sits on ถมทรายซุมน้ำอัดแน่น over ดินเดิมบดอัดแน่น, with a single mat and 0.10 m turn-downs at the edges. It carries a 1 cm isolation joint at the edge filled with sand-asphalt ('เว้นช่อง 1 ซม.อุดด้วยแอสฟัลท์ผสมทราย', dimensioned 0.01).
The 'ขยายพอกบันได' detail is the enlargement that the S-03 plan's พอก ค.ส.ล. callout points to. It shows S1 meeting S0 at the stair foot, with two 0.15 rises and a 0.30 / 0.20 chain.
The trailing ⌐ glyph on the slab bar tags is the hook symbol used throughout this set; kept in printed_as.
